## 2

The Earth is not flat. Its curved shape is supported by independent evidence, including satellite observations, lunar eclipses, time zones, changing star patterns, circumnavigation, and measurements of Earth’s curvature. Space photographs come from many countries, private companies, and separate missions, and their observations agree with one another.

## 3

Sunlight looks white, but it contains many colors. When sunlight enters Earth’s atmosphere, it bumps into tiny air molecules. Blue light gets scattered in all directions more strongly than most other colors, so blue light reaches our eyes from across the sky. At sunrise and sunset, light travels through more atmosphere, scattering much of the blue away and leaving more red and orange.

## 4

雨落在深夜的城市里，街灯被水雾晕成朦胧的光圈。屋檐不断滴水，像缓慢敲响的钟。空荡的街道映着窗户里的微光，偶尔有汽车驶过，轮胎卷起一片银亮的水花。风穿过树枝，带来潮湿的泥土气息。人们关紧门窗，屋内的灯光显得格外温暖，而雨声覆盖了所有喧闹，只留下安静而绵长的夜。
